applied.summary: AC5 claimed 'the 11 SC2 evidence files' under _bmad-output/evidence/openrig-sc2/ but the directory holds 38 files (rounds sc2-1-5 through sc2-7, 2026-09-28 to 2026-09-30); a manifest built to the stated count would leave 27 files unmapped and trip AC6/the coverage check's own 'unmapped' failure. Fixed: AC5 and the prereq row now enumerate the directory at implementation time and pin no count.

AC7 named tests/fleet/e2e/live-harness.ts as 'the evidence writer', but the SC2 fork-round evidence is written by tests/fleet/e2e/sc2-harness.ts (writeEvidence at :360, writes _bmad-output/evidence/openrig-sc2/); live-harness.ts (writeEvidence at :478) owns the fork-less df3-e2e/ corpus. As written, no fork-round evidence was ever stamped and the drift alarm never armed — AC7's own negative control. Fixed: AC7, Files-to-Modify, and the DOD Integration row retarget sc2-harness.ts's writeEvidence.

AC7 asserted 'schedule carries targetSessionId' but the persisted Schedule type (fork:src/types/schedule.ts:28) has no such field; adding one would be a second fork-grammar change contradicting DD-28.6 ('Z2's one fork change = factory_observe added to the artifact-kind union') and was absent from Files-to-Modify. Fixed: the durable notify target now rides the existing persisted protocolConfig bag on Schedule (e.g. notifyTargetSessionId) — no new Schedule field, DD-28.6 accounting preserved, no new files.

Spec Reference's fork-substrate bullet mixed fork:-prefixed and bare cross-repo cites (protocol-factory-exec.ts, protocol-factory-lifecycle.ts, protocol-run-outcome-notify.ts, schedules/schedule-repository.ts, runtime/watch-job-repository.ts); DD-28.8 makes bare cross-repo cites checker findings. Fixed: all five cites now carry fork: + the full src/ path, verified to resolve in the Solstice worktree fork.
